guard/30923.htm.text: Guard Dunst: Hello there Traveler! Welcome to Heine, the city of water and the capital of Innadril! My name is Dunst, I am one of the guards of this town. Pleased to meet you. Is there anything I can help you with?

links.text: Ask about the local lord and tax rate.

guard/30923-1.htm.text: Guard Dunst: Word comes from Giran that the dragon Antharas has awoken and is creating mayhem there. It is a good thing that Fafurion got all of his rage out of his system already. I must admit that the fear of him storming the castle has kept me up many a night...

@questlist.text: Quest list window (the server lists the quests this NPC has for you; shown only when there is more than one).
